finding: Skilled staff shortage tops Slovak business concerns in Wave 39
bullets: Skilled staff availability ranked as the most pressing problem among the seven tested for Slovak firms (n=239), scoring 6.64/10 — up from 6.07 in the previous wave, exceeding the EA's 6.57, signalling rising operational strain.
Costs of production or labour scored 6.62/10 (n=240), rising from 6.19 in the previous wave, though remaining below the EA average of 6.74 — highlighting cost pressures without yet matching peers.
Regulation scored 6.10/10 (n=236), easing 0.08 from the previous wave, yet still above the EA's 5.87 — suggesting persistent compliance burdens for Slovak firms.
chart_subtitle: Skilled staff scores 6.64/10 for Slovak firms.
